description: Angular component for managing OAuth2 domain settings in the Thingsboard UI, including form handling, URL redirection, and client creation dialog.

classes.name: DomainComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending EntityComponent to manage OAuth2 domain configurations, including form setup, URL redirection, and client management.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs the reactive form group with domain info, including validation rules.

methods.name: updateForm
methods.description: Updates the form with new domain info values.

methods.name: redirectURI
methods.description: Generates the redirect URI based on domain name and login processing URL.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Opens a dialog to create a new OAuth2 client and updates the form with the new client ID.
